dialog.title: About the reputation score
dialog.intro: Your reputation score changes based on your actions and on feedback from candidates.
dialog.gainText: Points are added when a recruiter fully verifies their information, and when a recruiter keeps job post statuses up to date.
dialog.lossText: Points are deducted for poor response rates to candidates and for job posts that violate community standards. Reaching a warning threshold lowers your company's visibility on the platform, and severe cases can lead to a permanent account lock. If a company is reported for fraud by a candidate with clear evidence (confirmed by the system), the account will be permanently deleted.
